I’m a BS Artificial Intelligence student who enjoys shipping real projects. Most of my work sits at the intersection of mobile development and AI. I build Flutter apps with Firebase backends, train predictive models, design databases, and write ETL pipelines. I’m currently leveling up my full-stack skills while keeping AI at the center of everything I do. I’m looking for a Flutter or mobile internship in Lahore (especially around Johar Town) where I can contribute to real client work and grow under good mentorship.

On the mobile side, I’m comfortable with Flutter and Dart, Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore, and building responsive, polished UIs. I also work with REST APIs and use Git regularly. For AI and data work, I use Python to train machine learning models, do data preprocessing, build ETL pipelines, and create predictive analytics systems. My main languages are Python, Dart, and C++. I’m solid with SQL, database design, and normalization. I care a lot about writing clean code and crafting good user interfaces.

I’m known for taking full ownership of projects, learning quickly, and staying focused on AI and clean architecture. I try to write code that’s both functional and maintainable, and I enjoy turning ideas into working products.
I’m currently studying for a BS in Artificial Intelligence at the University of Management and Technology (UMT) in Lahore. I started in 2023 and I’m still in the program.
Urdu is my native language, and I’m professionally fluent in English.

My full name is Muhammad Daniyal Azeem. My father’s name is Shahid Riaz. I am 21 years old. I completed my Secondary School (Matric) and Intermediate (FSc Pre-Medical) from Rashid Minhas Higher Secondary School, Ali Pur. My permanent address is Ali Pur, District Muzaffargarh. My present address is Lahore, Pakistan.

One of my main projects is the Clinic Portal — a multi-role Flutter app I built for managing a clinic. It has separate dashboards for Admin, Doctor, and Staff, with secure role-based navigation. I integrated Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore so everything is real-time and secure. The app handles appointment scheduling, patient history, and tracking of admitted patients. I also added interactive charts with fl_chart, PDF generation and printing, file sharing, and JazzCash payment support. It was a complete clinic management system designed to work smoothly on mobile (and web). You can find the code on my GitHub under the clinic repository.

I also built a Wallpaper App in Flutter. It’s a clean, modern app focused on good UI and smooth experience. Users can browse wallpapers by category, save favorites, download them, and set them as wallpaper with one tap. I paid a lot of attention to responsive layouts and performance so it feels snappy on different devices.

On the machine learning side, I created a Student Performance Prediction model in Python. I took historical student data, did preprocessing and feature engineering, trained the model, and evaluated it so it could give clear insights about academic performance.
I built an end-to-end ETL pipeline in Python that extracts, cleans, and transforms structured datasets, then turns the cleaned data into useful insights for decision-making.

I’ve designed several database systems from scratch. I created ER diagrams and applied normalization for Library, Hospital, and University systems, and wrote efficient SQL queries for data manipulation, reporting, and analysis.
LUMINA is a C++ project where I explored systems-level programming and software architecture concepts. It’s available on my GitHub.
I’ve also experimented with a social hub Flutter app and a simple backend API in JavaScript. My portfolio site is hosted at azeemuhammad.github.io.

Right now I’m focusing on becoming stronger in full-stack development, advanced Flutter patterns, and practical AI/ML workflows. I’m especially interested in Artificial Intelligence, Flutter mobile development, Machine Learning, and Clean Architecture. I’m open to onsite internships in Lahore (Johar Town area is convenient), as well as freelance work and collaborations related to AI, Flutter, or full-stack projects.
